q: Which make a fair model comparison? (Choose all that apply)
exp: Same questions, known answers written first, a consistent score, and speed or cost.
o: The same questions for every model
A good answer written down before you look at the results
Questions that can only be read one way
Using whichever model's answer you like best as the 'right' one
